findings.detail: The retained Azul Systems row matches the September 30 comparative schedule, while a distinct March 31 current-period Azul row is separately present.

rationale: PP03 is a row-local position-purity issue. Raw source shows Azul Systems in the prior-period comparative schedule at table 23 row 19 with interest rate 10.04% and 0.5% of net assets, distinct from the March 31 current-period row at table 15 row 10 with interest rate 9.95% and 0.3% of net assets. A row sourced from the earlier comparative schedule should not be retained as a March 31, 2024 holding.
